contributions.statement: Lint shared SKILL.md files with deterministic checks (size, naming, delegation of detail to reference files, presence of a validation step) and do not gate on LLM-judged smell checks.
contributions.evidence: §III-C, Table IV: 99% of 238 files have a smell, but 21/26 smells come from one quantized LLM judge with only aggregate F1 0.78, and §V concedes impact on agents is untested.

reason: Smells are inversions of grey-literature advice with no measured effect on agents, and 2608.08453 covers SKILL.md quality with a corpus 580x larger and deterministic detectors. Nothing here is not shown better elsewhere.
